answer: Locks are entered in haven, expire in relic, and dune lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 142 aliases therefore needs 55 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2938 identities would post 1605 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
